shuffled_layout: Reuse same-seed original fitted transport; permute only projected occupied slots, fixed across cells; retain empty mask and map values
permutation_seed: fifth child of numpy SeedSequence(replicate).spawn(5); original four stage streams unchanged
raw_vector: All 100 original coordinates, no mapping, scaling, padding or feature selection; linear 32D bottleneck and linear reconstruction, ReLU hidden layers
loss_policy: Unchanged native mean squared error plus 0.1 KL; raw-vector reconstruction units/normalization differ from map, so raw-vector joint comparison is not a pure layout ablation
training_budget: Same Step4A 100 shuffled pretrain epochs; independent fresh-Adam reconstruction/joint branches, 512 updates and two complete shuffled passes each
K_selection: Reuse verified baseline-only K decision from Step4A, not reference labels or new scores
initial_gate: Full-budget seed 0 plus separate-process technical duplicate for each new variant; bitwise outputs, weights, layout, logs and measured memory must pass before seeds 1-4
scoring: Frozen primary evaluator, all 45 grid points, canonical input order, all rare cells, existing safeguards and label-free matched counts
baseline_gate: Fresh baseline must exactly recover saved graph, partitions and metrics before new-control scoring
comparisons: Each new stage versus same-seed original-map stage, full baseline, first32 and PCA32; three within-variant stage contrasts, 30 five-seed contrasts total
failure_policy: Stop and preserve evidence; no automatic retries or replacement seeds; finish already-running siblings
stop_boundary: Finish and verify the two-control HP-CB Scanorama panel and report all results; no other datasets, manuscript edits, new tuning or weight sweeps
